text:
maya: kicked off concurrency sweep for redwood-qlm-v2-int8 on runner-v3. p50 fine, but p95/p99 spikes around 240-300 qps. attaching quick logs and dashboard link. :confused:

alex: can you paste the exact load command and runner binary/version? any prefetch or kv-cache flags?

maya: run command I used:
```
./eval-runner --model redwood-qlm-v2-int8 --runner-bin /usr/local/bin/runner-v3 \n  --concurrency 256 --target-qps 260 --batch-window-ms 5 --kv-cache enabled \n  --trace /tmp/trace-1959.json
```

riley: curious about prompt length distribution — long tails can cause uneven batching. also could be kv-cache eviction thrashing with concurrent writes. what % of requests are short vs long?

maya: payload sizes (sampled 10k): `len<=32: 62%`, `33-128: 28%`, `>128: 10%`. most short prompts but a few heavy ones.

jen: try toggling kv-cache to see delta. if kv eviction causes blocking we should see p95 drop when disabled. also check socket queues (SOMAXCONN) and any backpressure logs.

maya: quick test: disabled kv cache and re-ran at 260 qps. p95 dropped from ~220ms -> ~160ms, p99 also improved but token cost went up ~8%. dashboard: https://console.redwood.ai/dashboards/evals/1959876543

ci-bot: [CI] load-sweep job #452 finished. artifacts: https://ci.redwood.ai/artifacts/452 (traces, runner logs, telemetry) :white_check_mark:

alex: that smells like eviction/blocking. hypothesis: when a large prompt enters, it causes batch reorg + cache writes that delay subsequent short requests, causing tail bounce. try bumping `--batch-window-ms` to 8-12ms to let batches stabilize, or add jitter to request pacing. also check for "batch overflow" or "evicting kv" messages in runner logs.

maya: will run an overnigh sweep with batch-window 8ms and kv-cache off/on matrix and collect traces. scheduled runs: 260/300/340 qps. will post summary tomorrow.

riley: grep suggestion for logs: `grep -E "(evicting|backpressure|batch overflow|kv_write)" /var/log/runner/runner.log | tail -n 300`

maya: pasted a couple of lines from the runner log (trimmed):
```
[2026-05-03T03:12:14Z] evicting 512 entries from kv-cache (seq=1024) duration=7ms
[2026-05-03T03:12:14Z] batch overflow dropping 2 requests window_ms=5 size=256
[2026-05-03T03:12:14Z] backpressure: pause for 6ms (pending_batches=3)
```

jen: hmm. batch overflow + eviction + small window aligns. :thinking_face: if eviction takes ~7ms and batch window is 5ms you're overlapping. either increase batch window or move kv writes off the critical path (async).

alex: please open a GH issue and tag eng-runtime + eng-ml so we can track. include traces + command + log snippets. put hypothesis in the issue.

maya: opened GH: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runner/issues/1823 — added matrix results + traces + summary. tagging @alex @riley @jen.

riley: nice, I'll take a look at traces tomorrow morning (timezone PST). if it's eviction causing sync I can prototype async kv flush quickly.

maya: thanks all — I'll upload the overnight sweep CSV and perf traces once done. will also include cost-per-token calc so product can see tradeoffs. :heart:
